QuestInfo.name: Philius's Request
QuestInfo.0: The Black Mage's curse is freezing you along with the town of #m101050000#. You must seal the town away before the curse spreads to the outside world. Find #b#p1033100#, the Elder of Magic#k, to learn how.
QuestInfo.1: You must activate the pentacle at the entrance of Elluel. Follow #p1033100#'s instructions by #bgoing to the west entrance to town and activating the pentacle.#k
QuestInfo.2: You activated the pentacle. No one will be able to find #m101050000# now.

0.0: Sealing magic is simple enough, Your Highness. All you need do is activate the Pentacle at the entrance of town. Once you activate it, the town will be sealed away for at least 100 years...
0.1: Only you can do this, Your Highness. You're the only one with the authority.

yes.0: You only need to seal the #bdoor on the left side of town#k.\r\nThe door to the left only leads to the training center. Please hurry, Your Majesty.

no.0: No one else can do this, Your Majesty. I wish there was another way.

1.0: Maybe we're the lucky ones. While we sleep, Maple World will heal from the terrible things the Black Mage has done. I wonder what kind of world we'll wake up to?
1.1: If you think about it like that, the curse is almost like a gift. Your Highness... Please, have sweet dreams.

default.0: The #bportal#k is on the left side of town, Your Highness. Of course, you already knew that.
